description: This is a Python source file implementing a voice assistant bot using Pipecat framework, with functions for conversation management, weather info, and integration with OpenAI's real-time beta services.

classes.name: SessionProperties
classes.description: Holds session configuration for the OpenAI realtime beta service.

classes.name: AudioConfiguration
classes.description: Configures audio input settings for the session.

classes.name: AudioInput
classes.description: Specifies audio input parameters including transcription and turn detection.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeBetaLLMService
classes.description: LLM service interface for OpenAI's real-time beta API.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines a processing pipeline for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a task within the pipeline.

classes.name: OpenAILLMContext
classes.description: Context object for managing conversation state.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api
methods.description: Fetches weather data based on parameters.

methods.name: get_saved_conversation_filenames
methods.description: Retrieves list of saved conversation files.

methods.name: save_conversation
methods.description: Saves current conversation to a file.

methods.name: load_conversation
methods.description: Loads a conversation from a specified file.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Initializes and runs the bot with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, sets up transport and starts processing.
